title: Control: declared prose indicators, commented infection-traffic rows, author signatures and URL templates

provenance.method: constructed from import audit 35890-35901 P1 shapes: 35895 prose declaration beside a curated C2 table; 35899 infection-traffic URL with a trailing '<--' comment and an obfuscated author address after a signature rule; 35892/35900 publisher placeholder URLs (<rig>, <method>, <linkid:8>); and the Kong RAT beacon form '?log=<data>' whose published prefix is the documented endpoint
provenance.notes: A letter/hyphen query slot after '=' keeps the published URL prefix (matching semantics: a documented path whose parameter value is filled at runtime, including '?log=<data>' and '?id=<target-email-address>'). Mid-token placeholders and colon/digit placeholders are templates, not Indicators. A hunting-query code block and a negated 'are not indicators' sentence do not declare Indicators. Email added 2026-11-16 (email became a first-class IOC type, tl-candidates-v73): the defanged address bullet of the Indicators list is a publisher row (it was unrepresentable before, not a label change); the author signature address and the spoofed brand sender stay context.
